name: Alchemy
blurb: The art of concoction and transmutation. Alchemists brew potent elixirs, craft poisons, and transform base materials into something greater.

name: Animal Handling
blurb: Bond with the creatures of Vardoran. Animal handlers tame beasts, train mounts, and communicate with the wilds.

name: Archaeology
blurb: Unearth the secrets of the past. Archaeologists excavate ruins, decipher ancient texts, and recover lost artifacts.

name: Artifice
blurb: The craft of magical mechanisms. Artificers build enchanted devices, automata, and intricate traps.

name: Astrology
blurb: Read the stars and divine the future. Astrologers track celestial movements and interpret their meaning for kingdoms and individuals.

name: Blacksmithing
blurb: Shape metal into weapons, armor, and tools. Blacksmiths are the backbone of any settlement's industry.

name: Cooking
blurb: Nourish body and soul. Cooks prepare meals that grant temporary boons, heal the wounded, and lift spirits.

name: Diplomacy
blurb: Words are weapons. Diplomats negotiate treaties, resolve conflicts, and forge alliances between factions.

name: Divination
blurb: Pierce the veil of time and space. Diviners glimpse possible futures and uncover hidden truths.

name: Engineering
blurb: Build and maintain the infrastructure of civilization. Engineers design fortifications, bridges, and complex machinery.

name: Farming
blurb: Tend the land and reap its bounty. Farmers cultivate crops, raise livestock, and sustain communities.

name: Herbalism
blurb: The knowledge of plants and their uses. Herbalists gather rare flora and prepare natural remedies.

name: Lorekeeping
blurb: Guardians of history and knowledge. Lorekeepers maintain archives, chronicle events, and advise leaders.

name: Medicine
blurb: Heal the wounded and cure the afflicted. Physicians and surgeons save lives and study the body's mysteries.

name: Mercantile
blurb: Trade and commerce are the lifeblood of civilization. Merchants establish routes, manage markets, and accumulate wealth.

name: Mysticism
blurb: The study of the esoteric and the unknown. Mystics explore the boundaries of reality and commune with otherworldly forces.

name: Performance
blurb: Captivate audiences with art and spectacle. Performers inspire, distract, and manipulate through creative expression.

name: Survival
blurb: Thrive where others barely endure. Survivalists track, hunt, and navigate the wilds with unmatched skill.
